title: Epstein's eugenics plan to create his own race

tellings.quote:
thing with Epstein was he was obsessed
with eugenics and creating his own race.

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, Jay Anderson, says that Jeffrey Epstein, the wealthy financier, was obsessed with eugenics, the idea of improving humans through controlled breeding, and wanted to create his own race. Anderson passes this on from a woman named Juliet Byron, and ties it to Epstein's Zorro Ranch in New Mexico, from roughly the 1990s until 2019.
